Count regression model specification for tidymodels

count_reg.Rd

count_reg() defines a count regression model for the parsnip package, fitted with the "flexCountReg" engine (countreg). The count distribution is a main argument, so it can be tuned with tune.

Usage

count_reg(mode = "regression", family = NULL, engine = "flexCountReg")

Arguments

mode

the model mode; only "regression" is available.

family

the count distribution, one of the family values of countreg (for example "NB2", "PIG2" or "PLN"). Default "NB2".

engine

the fitting engine; only "flexCountReg".

Value

A count_reg model specification.

Details

Other countreg() arguments are engine arguments, set with parsnip::set_engine("flexCountReg", ...): for example method, dis_param_formula_1, underreport_formula, offset or stderr. Variables used only in those auxiliary formulas, and offset columns, must be kept in the data by any recipe (in a workflow, add them with workflows::add_variables() or give them a non-predictor role). A formula offset() term can be used with workflows::add_model(spec, formula = y ~ x + offset(log_exposure)). Case weights from tidymodels are passed to countreg() as frequency weights.

Predictions (type = "numeric") are the expected counts from predict.flexCountReg and have one row per row of new_data, with NA for rows with missing values.

Requires the parsnip package. The engine is registered when flexCountReg or parsnip is loaded.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("parsnip", quietly = TRUE)) {
  spec <- count_reg(family = "NB2") |>
    parsnip::set_engine("flexCountReg", method = "BFGS")
  fit <- parsnip::fit(spec, Total_crashes ~ lnaadt + lnlength,
                      data = washington_roads)
  predict(fit, new_data = washington_roads[1:5, ])
}
#> # A tibble: 5 × 1
#>   .pred
#>   <dbl>
#> 1 1.18 
#> 2 1.07 
#> 3 1.56 
#> 4 0.511
#> 5 1.22 
# }
